Now, Helen Mirren has once again scored a major award for playing her Royal Highness - this time for the play The Audience - at the 2015 Tony Awards in New York City on Sunday night. It also marked the 69-year-old's first ever Tony Award win, which is considered to be U.S. theater's highest honor. The Tony Award meant that Mirren was only a Grammy Award away from gaining so-called EGOT status as the winner of an Emmy, Grammy, Oscar and Tony - a distinction shared by only 12 entertainers.

@highlight

@highlight

@highlight

B. Best Leading Actor
C. Tommy Tune
D. The Queen
E. Elizabeth II
F. Lifetime Achievement Award
G. Grammy Award
H. Tony Award
I. Helen Mirren
